description: Synthetic ambiguous plan items (extraction confidence inside the adjudicator's band) with the decision a clinician would make. Fictional notes, no real patients. Labels: open = the note asks for the follow-up; discard = it does not (negated, done, declined, handled elsewhere); needs_human = the note cannot tell (conditional, a possibility, vague).
